Changed the default and added 4 config cases. Innocence: 16 passed across test_config.py + test_portal_invite.py. Guilt: restoring the vercel default failed 3 of the 4 new cases (live domain, no-vercel-alias, composed URL). Later rounds re-proved guilt for each added case individually.

4 findings, no blocker. (1) REAL: the config tests reconstruct the URL by hand instead of invoking a consumer, and the existing router tests fake the obsolete /portal/invite path, so every test could pass while the real composition rotted -> CURED: path extracted into InviteService.INVITE_PATH_TEMPLATE and a consumer-level test added that runs the real router with the real default (no monkeypatch) and asserts the mailed URL. (2) REAL: the production hostname becomes the default in every environment; a local backend could mail a production link for a locally minted token -> DECLARED as residual risk, not cured. (3) REAL: two sibling endpoints still claim success without mailing (portal_invite.resend_invitation, crm_portal_integration.send_portal_invite) -> out of scope, declared; neither is reachable from the workspace panel, which calls /api/portal/invite/send. (4) NIT: the field description embedded dated incident history -> CURED, description made contractual and the evidence moved here.

6 findings, no blocker. (1) REAL: no trailing-slash normalisation — the router concatenates base and path raw and the path starts with '/', so FRONTEND_PORTAL_URL=https://my.balizero.com/ would mail //portal/register; every existing case used a clean base -> CURED: rstrip on the base plus a dedicated case, guilt-proven (removing the rstrip fails it). (2) REAL: the tests assert a string, not liveness; a future rot of the domain would pass them -> DECLARED, a live probe is a separate change. (3) REAL: the GARUDA consumer has no consumer-level test -> DECLARED. (4) REAL: non-prod inherits the production default (same as codex 2) -> DECLARED. (5) NIT: the dead alias still lingers in cors_config.py, hybrid_auth.py and openapi.yaml -> out of scope, harmless (an allowed origin that resolves nowhere). (6) NIT: claimed the 200 was measured on the root only -> REFUTED: the measurement was taken on the full path https://my.balizero.com/portal/register?token=x, and is recorded as such in the ground line above.
